entry.title: New: Resolution 347 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE CORPORATION FOR NATIONAL AND COMMUNITY SERVICE, PURSUANT TO HAWAI‘I REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7, FOR A GRANT TO THE DEPARTMENT OF RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT

Allows for the receipt of $50,000 of federally-derived funds to provide community-based training and regional education from local historians, cultural practitioners, and other sources to AmeriCorps Volunteers in Service to America personnel. Funds would be used to provide community-based training and regional education to VISTA personnel.
